subject: Post-discovery: model assurance plan and retest scope
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: model assurance plan and retest scope

Hi Claire — thanks again for a detailed discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can move from discovery to a scoped PoC: 

Summary of what's important to Nimbus Health
- Accuracy on structured clinical question answering (Q&A) for discharge summaries and pre-visit notes
- Low hallucination on medication/diagnosis fields (FNR focus)
- Data residency (US region) and redaction of PHI during eval runs
- Predictable latency for batch extraction jobs (95th <= 350ms per token target)

Redwood's recommended starting configuration
- Candidate models: redwood-13b-fp16 (primary), redwood-7b-quant (fallback for throughput-critical paths)
- Evaluation artifacts attached: nimbus_prompt_suite_v1.jsonl (prompt set + expected outputs) and a small benchmark excerpt PDF with metric definitions
- Proposed evals: 10k sample tokens from your anonymized corpus run through both models + prompt templates, with automatic diff report highlighting quality deltas (precision/recall for entity extraction, hallucination rate, response length distribution)

Quality assurance / regression guardrails (what we will enforce during PoC)
1) Snapshot lock: we will freeze the model binary on the chosen variant for PoC runs and store a version hash.
2) Threshold gates: if the new model shows >5% relative degradation on FNR or hallucination compared to the baseline, auto-flag and recommend rollback.
3) Rollback triggers: manual approval for rollback in your environment, with a default automated fallback to the last validated snapshot if downstream errors are detected in the integration tests.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
- You: share a de-identified sample dataset (S3 link or secure upload) and confirm who from DS should be on the eval scope (we can redact PHI before ingestion).
- Us: run the baseline vs candidate evals and share a results dashboard + diff report within 3 business days of data receipt.
- Joint sync: 30-minute review to decide on model selection or staged rollout.

Budget/contract note: Marissa will follow up with a short estimate for a 2-week PoC reserved capacity and an optional rollback escrow add-on.

Attachments: nimbus_prompt_suite_v1.jsonl (prompts + labels), benchmark_excerpt_nimbus.pdf

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0127

--
Olga Petrov
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@nimbushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: ds-team@nimbushealth.com, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-11-14T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model assurance plan and retest scope

Thanks Olga — this looks good and concise. A couple of clarifying questions before we share data: 
1) For the Snapshot lock you mention, does Redwood provide an immutable artifact and version hash that we can store in our registry? We need that for our audit trail.
2) What exact metrics will you report for hallucination (we measure both entity hallucination and free-form hallucination differently)?
3) On PHI redaction: do you run redaction in our VPC or will samples transit Redwood storage? We prefer VPC-only handling for the PoC if possible.

Procurement: we will loop in approvals after we see the PoC estimate.

Claire
Sr. Director Data Science
Nimbus Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@nimbushealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-14T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model assurance plan and retest scope

Claire — great questions. Short answers and operational details below.

1) Snapshot artifact: yes — we produce an immutable snapshot (SHA256 hash + model metadata) and can export the manifest so you can ingest the fingerprint into your internal model registry. We'll also include the exact compilation/quantization profile used during the eval.

2) Hallucination metrics: we'll include both a structured-entity hallucination rate (false positives on canonical fields like medication, dosage, diagnosis codes) and an NER-informed free-form hallucination score (token-level divergence against labeled references). The diff report flags regressions at both the per-metric and per-prompt level so you can see which prompt templates cause most variance.

3) PHI handling: we support three modes — (a) Redwood-hosted ingestion with immediate redaction + ephemeral storage (no persistence), (b) VPC-hosted evals where our workers execute inside your VPC with no data egress, and (c) on-prem runbook for air-gapped evaluation. For the PoC, we can prioritize the VPC mode (option b) — need a short network access window to stand up the workers.

Operational ask: Claire, can you confirm DS contact who will provide the S3 URI or grant us the temporary role for the VPC eval? Once received, we will schedule the run and aim for the 3-business-day turnaround.

Marissa — can you draft a 2-week reserved capacity estimate and include an add-on line for the rollback escrow? Include both VPC and Redwood-hosted pricing so they have choices.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Product — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@nimbushealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: model assurance plan and retest scope

Claire — I pulled preliminary numbers for a short PoC (2 weeks) and included high-level options. I'll follow with a precise emailed estimate and a DocuSign link if you want to accept the PoC terms. High-level: 
- Redwood-hosted PoC (shared infra, redaction mode): $9,500 — includes 10k-token eval for two models, diff report, and one review session.
- VPC-hosted PoC (dedicated workers in your subnet): $18,750 — includes setup assistance, audit manifest, and a snapshot export for your registry.
- Rollback escrow add-on: $2,000 — ensures we maintain last-validated snapshot available for immediate rollback for 30 days.

If you confirm the VPC path, we'll provide a runbook for temporary role/config and a short checklist for your infra team. Also — Claire, we will not persist any sample data outside of ephemeral evaluation artifacts unless you explicitly authorize storage.

Next: if Claire confirms (DS contact + chosen hosting mode), we'll schedule the eval kickoff for next Monday.

Best,
Marissa
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
